m.t: Uvědomuješ si, že to federálové nepustí k vodě?

m.t: Možná mě už nikdy nepustí domů.
m.e: They might never let me come home again.

m.t: Vědí, že jste nemocný, vědí, jak dlouho vám zbývá. a vědí, že vás na kauci nepustí.

m.e: She's in her room and she won't let me near her.

m.e: She said she wouldn't let me go unless she came with me, so here she is.

m.e: Man, Francine really ain't letting you get a word in edgewise, is she?

m.t: Myslel jsem, že vás ke mně nepustí.

m.t: Zítra mě možná ani nepustí do firmy.

m.t: V nejbližší době mě ven nepustí.

m.e: They're not going to let her go.

m.e: No one will tell me anything. I can't go and see him.

m.e: A reliable person who prepares everything in advance.

m.e: Or that she takes your head first, so that you do not need to see your child die.

m.e: You're using it, aren't you?

m.t: Používáš mě jako návnadu?
m.e: Are you using me as bait?

m.t: Používáš humor jako sebeobranu.
m.e: You use humor as a form of self-defence.

m.t: Myslím, že je na čase, aby se s ní rozešel.
m.e: I think it's time for him to break things off with her.

m.e: I broke up with my mother, so can I stay here?

m.e: Remember he broke up with you?

m.e: Why would he fall out with someone like you?

m.e: I mean, she tried to kill herself when you broke up with her.

m.e: Well, we didn't have a choice when I broke up with my mother.

m.e: But I just broke up with my girlfriend.

m.e: You want me to break up with a woman I haven't dated in 30 years!

m.e: You broke up with her because she wanted to go skydiving?

m.e: He's been fighting on his own since he broke with the Rebellion.

m.e: Did your doggie break up with you too?

m.e: All right, look, I just broke up with April.

m.e: No wonder Ben broke up with you.

m.e: See why I broke up with her?

m.t: Ale já se právě rozešel s holkou.
m.e: But I just broke up with my girlfriend.

m.t: - Co kdyby ses za mě rozešel s Camillou ty?
m.e: - Okay. What if you break up with Camilla for me?

m.t: Nemůžu uvěřit, že ses se mnou doopravdy rozešel jenom proto, že ti to řekl tvůj poručík.
m.e: I can't believe that you actually broke up with me just because your lieutenant told you to.

m.e: The guy I usually play music with kind of just broke up with my sister.

m.e: Did your doggie break up with you too?
